title: Du Gard to White, Brussels, 10 June 1656 (Thurloe State Papers v.78-79): an enciphered cover address

steps.what: Extracted piece (b) from Birch's Thurloe State Papers on British History Online.

Applied every 1653-60 royalist and Commonwealth key from cryptiana (Marshall, Barwick-Hyde, Stamford, Butler, Charles II intercepted 1655, Kingston, Westrope, Hague agent/Blake) to piece (b) with apply_keys.py, scored by quadgram models: nothing readable.
Split under the one-key rule from thurloe (four unrelated pieces of the Thurloe State Papers): piece (b) gets its own entry; ciphertext file moved here; shared scripts stay in targets/thurloe/.

outcome.method_basis: A 27-token cover address that no 1653-60 key on cryptiana reads; too short for any statistical attack.
outcome.notes: Original in Bodleian Rawlinson A vol. xxxviii, not digitised; Birch's print is the only witness. Split on 14 Oct 2026 from thurloe.

credits.note: Thurloe State Papers (1742): the only witness of the four intercepts

prior.where: Listed as undeciphered by Tomokiyo (cryptiana item #9); Birch's transcriptions are the only online witness and carry no decipherment.
